base_experiment: EXP-TOPTAIL-RANK01 R2 (hybrid loss: SmoothL1 + top-tail pairwise)
changed_variable: training-time prefix source only: C0 uses the Oracle's sequence S*_{t-1}; T1 uses the model's OWN on-policy picks S_hat_{t-1} (both the SetConditioner state AND the dense-utility target are rebuilt from this prefix at every step). Loss formula, frozen encoder, scorer, SetConditioner/EmptySetToken/UtilityHead all identical to C0.

arms.C0: R2 + cosine + FROZEN B0 encoder + ORACLE prefix -- existing EXP-TOPTAIL-RANK01/R2 checkpoint, reused verbatim, not retrained
arms.T1: R2 + cosine + FROZEN B0 encoder + ON-POLICY (model-generated) prefix -- new training this experiment

sanity_checks: PASSED (tests/test_exp_onpolicy_prefix01.py, 7/7: (1) t=0 state identical to oracle-prefix run; (2) model-selected index actually enters the prefix; (3) selected candidate removed from the next valid set, no duplicates; (4) dense-utility target recomputed from the CURRENT model prefix, not the oracle's; (5) no gradient flows through argmax/index selection; (6) R2 gradient flows normally to SetConditioner/UtilityHead; (7) FULL MEMORY semantics preserved -- every step scores the full candidate bank)
gradient_semantics: argmax-based candidate selection is always under torch.no_grad()/detached -- NOT a differentiable-Top-K experiment. Only the R2 loss's own backward (through SetConditioner/UtilityHead, from SmoothL1/pairwise evaluated at the on-policy state) carries gradient.
explicitly_not_run: combination with EXP-ORACLE-CHOICE01's Oracle-Choice CE loss
